name: hedge
description: Headless + edge CMS built for Cloudflare Workers

AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions, invite links and delivery API keys. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` — changing it later signs everyone out and invalidates every key.

DB.description: D1 database holding sites, users, collections, entries and members. Created for you; migrations run on every deploy.

MEDIA.description: R2 bucket for uploaded media. Requires R2 to be enabled on your account.

EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email Sending, used for invites, password resets and newsletters. Deploying works without it — run `wrangler email sending enable <your domain>` when you are ready to send.

ENVIRONMENT.description: Leave as `production`. Anything else is treated as local development: email is composed and logged but never handed to the provider, and invite and reset links are printed to the Worker log instead.

APP_NAME.description: The name this deployment calls itself in the admin and in every email it sends — subject lines, greetings and footers. Set it to your own product or organisation name.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Leave empty unless you already have a custom domain. Empty means Hedge uses the origin of whatever request it is answering, which is correct for the generated `workers.dev` subdomain. With a domain, set the **full origin including the scheme** — `https://cms.example.com`, not `cms.example.com` — and no trailing slash. A value that is not a URL is rejected when the deployment builds its auth, and every sign-in and admin request fails with a 500. Invite links, media URLs and the MCP OAuth identifier all follow this value.

INSTALLED_BY.description: Leave as `button`. It records how this deployment was created (`button`, `installer` or `cli`) so that **Settings → About & updates** shows the update instructions that actually apply to it; the other two install paths set their own value without asking. Display only: nothing about how the Worker runs reads this, and a wrong value costs an unhelpful instruction, never access.

WORKER_NAME.description: Leave empty. It is only set by the Hedge installer, which lets you name the deployment; a button deployment is always called `hedge-cms`. A Worker is not told its own script name at run time, and the dashboard updater has to address itself, so a renamed deployment records its name here.

EMAIL_FROM.description: **System sender for the whole deployment**, not per site: invites, password resets, member sign-in links, and every newsletter from every site are sent from this address. It must be on a domain onboarded with `wrangler email sending enable <your domain>`. Safe to leave empty and set later in the admin under Settings → Email — until one of the two is set, nothing sends.

EMAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Display name shown next to the system sender address, e.g. `Acme Editorial`. Also deployment-wide, and also overridable later under Settings → Email.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd apps/admin build && bun run --cwd apps/api build
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run db:migrate:remote && bun run --cwd apps/api deploy
